title: torch._inductor.aoti_compile_and_packagefails with CUDA kernels inside of atorch.cond
error_description: A model that uses torch.cond to choose between two CUDA kernels runs fine eager, but `torch._inductor.aoti_load_package` fails to execute the exported model correctly. The error message is: 'Exception in aoti_torch: Unable to find a proxy executor to run custom ops. Please check if there is a json file generated in the same directory as the so, or use torch._inductor.aoti_compile_and_package to package everything into a PT2 artifact.' Note: without the `torch.cond`, everything works fine.
